title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-008
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of an official FAA/USAF interview with a JAL flight crew regarding a UFO sighting, and it contains detailed accounts of multiple encounters.

encounters.summary: JAL Captain Kenju Terauchi reported observing a large mothership and two smaller craft while piloting a cargo flight over Alaska, noting the objects matched the speed of his aircraft and displayed advanced propulsion.
encounters.entity_behavior: maintained formation with aircraft, performed rapid maneuvers, avoided detection by positioning in dark areas
encounters.quote: It jumped in front of us, very unusual. They took such unexpected action.

encounters.summary: Captain Terauchi reported a previous sighting five years prior to the 1986 event, involving a large mothership near Formosa.
encounters.quote: When we start climb we saw left-hand side big mothership

encounters.summary: Captain Terauchi reported a second sighting at his home involving bright lights in the sky during the daytime.
encounters.quote: we saw bright lights, I guess maybe ah 10,000 feet
